purpose: Insure a separately trained high-fidelity image generation/editing result whose inherited license already restricts distribution geography; prefer full trained Diffusers checkpoint over same-outcome Comfy quantization.

additions.group: 地域制限付き高解像度画像生成・編集の独自蒸留成果
additions.reason_selected: MiniMax H3動画原本から追加のDMD 8-step画像拡散蒸留、32B→4Bテキストエンコーダ蒸留、単一画像用の新decoder、Qwen3.5-9Bベースの学習済みprompt upsamplerを持つ別学習成果。単なる再量子化でなく、他の画像モデルやH3原重みだけでこの差分は容易に再構築できない。保険の独自性を満たす。
additions.quality_positive: 作者一次記事はB200 4MP BF16 2.6秒 vs元H3 12.4秒、8MPで5.8 vs30.6秒を報告。作者HF cardは8MPで手書きpromptの場合B200/batch1約9秒、upscaler付では合計101GB VRAMと記載。条件差を混ぜて一つのベンチとしない。
additions.quality_negative: 作者測定のみ。4bitで微細構図が変化し、手、細かい文字、2/4MPでの人物に欠陥。ブログの軽量DiT20BとHFモデルメタ33.123Bに解釈相違があり、全 learned partパラメータ数は未確定。MiniMax H3 Community LicenseはEU、UK、韓国、米国を原則除外し、出力用途と第三者権利・再配布を制限。日本国内でも個別条件・主体・サービス提供先を審査。
additions.evidence_scope: Developer article dated Nov3 and immutable HF source snapshot + original MiniMax Community license metadata and hashed text (no model payload)
additions.decision_change_reason: Immutable first-party source v7f98..., 54 files, selected 44 files/15 trained safetensors 99,840,428,064 bytes; separate source modifications (trained upsampler, distilled encoder and dedicated decoder) independently established; geographic limits favor cautious S1 metadata work; formal selection remains research-only/authorization blocked until rights and all-pipeline parameter census.

parameter_gate.evidence_kind: HF safetensors total likely transformer only; original Diffusers component tensors include prompt upsampler text encoder decoder; whole learned pipeline not enumerated
parameter_gate.note: Do NOT call this model 33B total or 20B total. All components and actual dtype/census must be verified before final acquisition lock.

restriction_assessment.observed: MiniMax H3 Community License limits Applicable Territory, excludes EU/UK/Republic of Korea/USA unless separate license; no verified government restriction or model takedown.
restriction_assessment.scenario: Further geographical, cloud or platform distribution restrictions may impair future legal access, but probability not estimated.

additions.falsification_condition: Reject or return to HOLD if release proves identical packaging only, legal region/subject/duty cannot be satisfied, complete learned count is over permitted threshold without verified quant exception, compatibility fails, or complete cost exceeds 4TB/200GB physical threshold; no imminent ban proof is needed for candidate retention.
